name: ACID BURROWER
desc: A horse-sized insect with digging claws and acidic blood.
motives: Burrow, drag away, feed, reposition

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Burrower can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Earth Eruption
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Burrower burst out of the ground. All creatures within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Spit Acid
features.desc: Make an attack against all targets in front of the Burrower within Close range. Targets the Burrower succeeds against take 2d6 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Acid Bath
features.desc: When the Burrower takes Severe damage, all creatures within Close range are bathed in their acidic blood, taking 1d10 physical damage. This splash covers the ground within Very Close range with blood, and all creatures other than the Burrower who move through it take 1d6 physical damage.

name: Atototl
desc: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.
motives: Avoid, escape, misdirect

features.name: Wind Lord
features.desc: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

features.name: Stone of Omens
features.desc: Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl’s remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

features.name: Archer's Bane
features.desc: When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can Spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker’s damage back to them.

name: Ahuizotl
desc: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.
motives: Ambush, drown, restrain

features.name: Aquatic Attacker
features.desc: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Tail Swat
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

features.name: Drag and Bag
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily Restrain them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets Restrained in this way.

name: BEAR
desc: A large bear with thick fur and powerful claws.
motives: Climb, defend territory, pummel, track

features.name: Overwhelming Force
features.desc: Targets who mark HP from the Bear's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Bite
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage and the target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Bear makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Bugboar
desc: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.
motives: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

features.name: Surprise!
features.desc: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it’s marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra 1d8 damage.

features.name: Brutal
features.desc: When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can Mark a Stress to deal an extra 1d6 damage.

features.name: Warheart
features.desc: When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can Spend a Fear to negate it.

name: CAVE OGRE
desc: A massive humanoid who sees all sapient life as food.
motives: Bite off heads, feast, rip limbs, stomp, throw enemies

features.name: Ramp Up
features.desc: You must Spend a Fear to spotlight the Ogre. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Bone Breaker
features.desc: The Ogre's attacks deal direct damage.

features.name: Hail of Boulders
features.desc: Mark a Stress to pick up heavy objects and throw them at all targets in front of the Ogre within Far range. Make an attack against these targets. Targets the Ogre succeeds against take 1d10+2 physical damage. If they succeed against more than one target, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rampaging Fury
features.desc: When the Ogre marks 2 or more HP, they can rampage. Move the Ogre to a point within Close range and deal 2d6+3 direct physical damage to all targets in their path.

name: Common Ruffian
desc: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.
motives: Do violence, seek security and survival

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1d8 physical damage each.  Combine this damage.

features.name: Survival Instinct
features.desc: When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene.  Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

name: CONSTRUCT
desc: A roughly humanoid being of stone and steel, assembled and animated by magic.
motives: Destroy environment, serve creator, smash target, trample groups

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Construct can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Weak Structure
features.desc: When the Construct marks HP from physical damage, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Trample
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in the Construct's path when they move. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d8 physical damage.

features.name: Overload
features.desc: Before rolling damage for the Construct's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll. The Construct can then take the spotlight again.

features.name: Death Quake
features.desc: When the Construct marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Construct succeeds against take 1d12+2 magic damage.

name: COURTIER
desc: An ambitious and ostentatiously dressed socialite.
motives: Discredit, gain favor, maneuver, scheme

features.name: Mockery
features.desc: Mark a Stress to say something mocking and force a target within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (14) to see if they can save face. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is Vulnerable until the scene ends.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.desc: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Courtier convinces a crowd or prominent individual that the target is the cause of their current conflict or misfortune.

name: Darkweave Crawler
desc: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.
motives: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

features.name: Minion (3)
features.desc: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Skin-Crawling
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to mark a Stress.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them.  Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Darkweave Venom
features.desc: Reaction: When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll.

name: Darkweave Queen
desc: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.
motives: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Den Mother
features.desc: Once per scene, Spend 2 Fear to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Quicker Than She Looks
features.desc: Spend a Fear to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.

features.name: Darkfang Envenomation
features.desc: When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can Spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

name: Darkweave Spinner
desc: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.
motives: Bite, stick to the darkness

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.desc: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can Spend a Fear to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Darkweave Swarmlings
desc: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.
motives: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

features.name: Horde (1d4)
features.desc: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 physical damage instead.

features.name: Get 'em Off, Get 'em Off
features.desc: When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a d6 when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must mark a Stress or you gain a Fear.

name: DEEPROOT DEFENDER
desc: A burly vegetable-person with grasping vines.
motives: Ambush, grab, protect, pummel

features.name: Ground Slam
features.desc: Slam the ground, knocking all targets within Very Close range back to Far range. Each target knocked back this way must mark a Stress.

features.name: Grab and Drag
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, Spend a Fear to pull them into Melee range, deal 1d6+2 physical damage, and Restrain them until the Defender takes Severe damage.

name: DIRE WOLF
desc: A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.
motives: Defend territory, harry, protect pack, surround, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.desc: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hobbling Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 direct physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.

name: Elk
desc: A large deer.
motives: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

features.name: Headbutt
features.desc: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals 1d12+2 physical damage instead of its standard damage.

features.name: Bolt
features.desc: When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

name: Falcon
desc: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.
motives: Circle, clutch, dive, spy

features.name: Nimble Flyer
features.desc: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.

features.name: Dive Bomb
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: GIANT MOSQUITOES
desc: Dozens of fist-sized mosquitoes, flying together for protection.
motives: Fly away, harass, steal blood

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Mosquitoes have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Flying
features.desc: While flying, the Mosquitoes have a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodsucker
features.desc: When the Mosquitoes' attack causes a target to mark HP, you can mark a Stress to force the target to mark an additional HP.

name: GIANT RAT
desc: A cat-sized rodent skilled at scavenging and survival.
motives: Burrow, hunger, scavenge, wear down

features.name: Minion (3)
features.desc: The Rat is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Rat, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Rats within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: GIANT SCORPION
desc: A human-sized arachnid with tearing claws and a stinging tail.
motives: Ambush, feed, grapple, poison

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against two targets within Melee range.

features.name: Venomous Stinger
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, Spend a Fear to deal 1d4+4 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (16). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Scorpion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: GLASS SNAKE
desc: A clear serpent with a massive head that leaves behind a glass shard trail wherever they go.
motives: Climb, feed, keep distance, scare

features.name: Armor-Shredding Shards
features.desc: After a successful attack against the Snake within Melee range, the attacker must mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an HP.

features.name: Spinning Serpent
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Snake succeeds against take 1d6+1 physical damage.

features.name: Spitter
features.desc: Spend a Fear to introduce a d6 Spitter Die. When the Snake is in the spotlight, roll this die. On a result of 5 or higher, all targets in front of the Snake within Far range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d4 physical damage. The Snake can take the spotlight a second time this GM turn.

name: Grimmling Warband
desc: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.
motives: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Cowardly
features.desc: When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

name: ARCHER GUARD
desc: A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the settlement's colors.
motives: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Hobbling Shot
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have disadvantage on Agility Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.

name: BLADED GUARD
desc: An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the settlement's colors.
motives: Arrest, close gates, make it through the day, pin down

features.name: Shield Wall
features.desc: A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the Guard must succeed on an Agility Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within Melee range of another guard in the line, the Difficulty increases by the total number of guards in that line.

features.name: Detain
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they break free with a successful attack, Finesse Roll, or Strength Roll.

name: HEAD GUARD
desc: A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice.
motives: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

features.name: Rally Guards
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight the Head Guard and up to 2d4 allies within Far range.

features.name: On My Signal
features.desc: Countdown (5). When the Head Guard is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within Far range make a standard attack with advantage against the nearest target within their range. If any attacks succeed on the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Harpy
desc: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.
motives: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

features.name: Toxic Aura
features.desc: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Surprise Attack
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy’s path. On a success, the Harpy deals 3d6 physical damage.

name: HARRIER
desc: A nimble fighter armed with javelins.
motives: Flank, harry, kite, profit

features.name: Maintain Distance
features.desc: After making a standard attack, the Harrier can move anywhere within Far range.

features.name: Fall Back
features.desc: When a creature moves into Melee range to make an attack, you can mark a Stress before the attack roll to move anywhere within Close range and make an attack against that creature. On a success, deal 1d10+2 physical damage.

name: JAGGED KNIFE BANDIT
desc: A cunning criminal in a cloak bearing one of the gang's iconic knives.
motives: Escape, profit, steal, throw smoke

features.name: Climber
features.desc: The Bandit climbs just as easily as they run.

features.name: From Above
features.desc: When the Bandit succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 1d10+1 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

name: JAGGED KNIFE HEXER
desc: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.
motives: Command, hex, profit

features.name: Curse
features.desc: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily Curse them. While the target is Cursed, you can mark a Stress when that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

features.name: Chaotic Flux
features.desc: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+3 magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.

name: JAGGED KNIFE KNEEBREAKER
desc: An imposing brawler carrying a large club.
motives: Grapple, intimidate, profit, steal

features.name: I've Got 'Em
features.desc: Creatures Restrained by the Kneebreaker take double damage from attacks by other adversaries.

features.name: Hold Them Down
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes no damage but is Restrained and Vulnerable. The target can break free, clearing both conditions, with a successful Strength Roll or is freed automatically if the Kneebreaker takes Major or greater damage.

name: JAGGED KNIFE LACKEY
desc: A thief with simple clothes and small daggers, eager to prove themselves.
motives: Escape, profit, throw smoke

features.name: Minion (3)
features.desc: The Lackey is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Lackey, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jagged Knife Lackeys within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: JAGGED KNIFE LIEUTENANT
desc: A seasoned bandit in quality leathers with a strong voice and cunning eyes.
motives: Bully, command, profit, reinforce

features.name: Tactician
features.desc: When you spotlight the Lieutenant, mark a Stress to also spotlight two allies within Close range.

features.name: More Where That Came From
features.desc: Summon three Jagged Knife Lackeys, who appear at Far range.

features.name: Coup de Grace
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+12 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Lieutenant makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: JAGGED KNIFE SHADOW
desc: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.
motives: Ambush, conceal, divide, profit

features.name: Backstab
features.desc: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal 1d6+6 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Cloaked
features.desc: Become Hidden until after the Shadow's next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.

name: JAGGED KNIFE SNIPER
desc: A lanky bandit striking from cover with a shortbow.
motives: Ambush, hide, profit, reposition

features.name: Unseen Strike
features.desc: If the Sniper is Hidden when they make a successful standard attack against a target, they deal 1d10+4 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

name: Kelpie
desc: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
motives: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

features.name: Captivating
features.desc: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Kelpie’s Melee range.

features.name: Heart's Desire
features.desc: After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Shapeshifter
features.desc: Mark a Stress to change the Kelpie’s physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon.  A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

features.name: Enchant
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage.  While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC’s most deeply held morals.

name: Masque Muerte
desc: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.
motives: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

features.name: Libre
features.desc: The Masque Muerte can’t be Restrained.

features.name: Heel Turn
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and is temporarily Vulnerable as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.

features.name: Spectral Suplex
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte suplex a Restrained PC, dealing 1d10+6 magic damage to them.

features.name: Unmasking Death
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Tag Team
features.desc: When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can spend a Fear to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.  While Pinned, the target is Restrained and takes an extra 1d12 magic damage from the Masque Muerte’s attacks.

name: Mechanorb
desc: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.
motives: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

features.name: Hive Mind
features.desc: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

features.name: Adaptive Tactics (Pool)
features.desc: _Pool_. When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

name: MERCHANT
desc: A finely dressed trader with a keen eye for financial gain.
motives: Buy low and sell high, create demand, inflate prices, seek profit

features.name: Preferential Treatment
features.desc: A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll against the Merchant gains a discount on purchases. A PC who fails on a Presence Roll against the Merchant must pay more and has disadvantage on future Presence Rolls against the Merchant.

features.name: The Runaround
features.desc: When a PC rolls a 14 or lower on a Presence Roll made against the Merchant, they must mark a Stress.

name: MINOR CHAOS ELEMENTAL
desc: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.
motives: Confound, destabilize, transmogrify

features.name: Arcane Form
features.desc: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Sickening Flux
features.desc: Mark a HP to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until their next rest or they clear a HP.

features.name: Remake Reality
features.desc: Spend a Fear to transform the area within Very Close range into a different biome. All targets within this area take 2d6+3 direct magic damage.

features.name: Magical Reflection
features.desc: When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half the damage they dealt.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: MINOR FIRE ELEMENTAL
desc: A living flame the size of a large bonfire.
motives: Encircle enemies, grow in size, intimidate, start fires

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Elemental can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Scorched Earth
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. The ground within Very Close range of that point immediately bursts into flames. All creatures within this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8 magic damage from the flames. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Explosion
features.desc: Spend a Fear to erupt in a fiery explosion. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against take 1d8 magic damage and are knocked back to Far range.

features.name: Consume Kindling
features.desc: Three times per scene, when the Elemental moves onto objects that are highly flammable, consume them to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: MINOR DEMON
desc: A crimson-hued creature from the Circles Below, consumed by rage against all mortals.
motives: Act erratically, corral targets, relish pain, torment

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Demon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: All Must Fall
features.desc: When a PC rolls a failure with Fear while within Close range of the Demon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Hellfire
features.desc: Spend a Fear to rain down hellfire within Far range. All targets within the area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d20+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Reaper
features.desc: Before rolling damage for the Demon's attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to the Demon's current number of marked HP.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: MINOR TREANT
desc: An ambulatory sapling rising up to defend their forest.
motives: Crush, overwhelm, protect

features.name: Minion (5)
features.desc: The Treant is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Treant, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Minor Treants within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Mountain Troll
desc: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.
motives: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Stolen Armor
features.desc: Countdown. When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see “Enraged Mountain Troll”).

features.name: Flail Swipe
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

features.name: Enraged Mountain Troll
features.desc:
The Troll loses their “Stolen Armor” and “Flail Swipe” features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the “Double Swipe” feature and replace “Skull Flail” with the following standard attack:
**Claw Swipe**: Very Close | 1d10+3 phy

features.name: Double Swipe
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

name: Octopus
desc: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motives: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape

features.name: Grapple
features.desc: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Squirt Ink
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Octopus squirt ink.  On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range.  Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming Vulnerable until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

name: GREEN OOZE
desc: A moving mound of translucent green slime.
motives: Camouflage, consume and multiply, creep up, envelop

features.name: Slow
features.desc: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.desc: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.desc: Make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. The target must mark an additional Stress when they make an action roll. If the Ooze takes Severe damage, the target is freed.

features.name: Split
features.desc: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can Spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: TINY GREEN OOZE
desc: A small moving mound of translucent green slime.
motives: Camouflage, creep up

features.name: Acidic Form
features.desc: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

name: RED OOZE
desc: A moving mound of translucent flaming red slime.
motives: Camouflage, consume and multiply, ignite, start fires

features.name: Creeping Fire
features.desc: The Ooze can only move within Very Close range as their normal movement. They light any flammable object they touch on fire.

features.name: Ignite
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 1d8 magic damage and is Ignited until they're extinguished with a successful Finesse Roll (14). While Ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they make an action roll.

features.name: Split
features.desc: When the Ooze has 3 or more HP marked, you can Spend a Fear to split them into two Tiny Red Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: TINY RED OOZE
desc: A small moving mound of translucent flaming red slime
motives: Blaze, camouflage

features.name: Burning
features.desc: When a creature within Melee range deals damage to the Ooze, they take 1d6 direct magic damage.

name: Panther
desc: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.
motives: Climb trees, pounce, stalk

features.name: Shadow Stalker
features.desc: While Hidden, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 1d12+2 physical damage.

name: PETTY NOBLE
desc: A richly dressed and adorned aristocrat brimming with hubris.
motives: Abuse power, gather resources, mobilize minions

features.name: My Land, My Rules
features.desc: All social actions made against the Noble on their land have disadvantage.

features.name: Guards, Seize Them!
features.desc: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4 Bladed Guards, who appear at Far range to enforce the Noble's will.

features.name: Exile
features.desc: Spend a Fear and target a PC. The Noble proclaims that the target and their allies are exiled from the noble's territory. While exiled, the target and their allies have disadvantage during social situations within the Noble's domain.

name: Phantom
desc: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.
motives: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

features.name: Incorporeal
features.desc: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Fear Aura
features.desc: A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or mark a Stress.

features.name: Lingering Haunt
features.desc: Countdown (1d6). When the Phantom is defeated, you can spend a Fear to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom’s HP and immediately spotlight them.

name: PIRATE CAPTAIN
desc: A charismatic sea dog with an impressive hat, eager to raid and plunder.
motives: Command, make 'em walk the plank, plunder, raid

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.desc: When the Captain marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reinforcements
features.desc: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon a Pirate Raiders Horde, which appears at Far range.

features.name: No Quarter
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target who has three or more Pirates within Melee range of them. The Captain leads the Pirates in hurling threats and promises of a watery grave. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target marks 1d4+1 Stress. On a success, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: PIRATE RAIDERS
desc: Seafaring scoundrels moving in a ravaging pack.
motives: Gang up, plunder, raid

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Raiders have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.desc: When the Raiders mark 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

name: PIRATE TOUGH
desc: A thickly muscled and tattooed pirate with melon-sized fists.
motives: Plunder, raid, smash, terrorize

features.name: Swashbuckler
features.desc: When the Tough marks 2 or fewer HP from an attack within Melee range, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Clear the Decks
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to move into Melee range of the target, dealing 3d4 physical damage and knocking the target back to Close range.

name: Poltergeist
desc: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.
motives: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Possessor
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

features.name: Ghost Storm
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 1d12+2 physical damage.  Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Rabble Mawb
desc: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a “mawb” of a dozen.
motives: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Come Back Worse
features.desc: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can spend a Fear to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

name: Redcap Biters
desc: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.
motives: Bring ’em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ankle Weights
features.desc: A PC must mark a Stress to move out of the Biters’ Melee range.

name: Redcap Breaker
desc: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motives: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

features.name: Backbreaker
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is Restrained until they clear a HP.

features.name: Kneecapper
features.desc: When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can Spend a Fear to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

name: Redcap Butcher
desc: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.
motives: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble

features.name: Chop Happy
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Knife Thrower
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is Hidden, they make the attack with advantage.

name: Redcap Candlemaker
desc: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal’s hand.
motives: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light

features.name: Hand of Glory
features.desc: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is Hidden.

features.name: Torchbearer
features.desc: The light of the Candlemaker’s Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

features.name: dance in the Flames
features.desc: Spend a token from this stat block.  The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll.  Targets who fail take 2d10 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Redcap Skinner
desc: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motives: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shallow Cuts
features.desc: When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Rugaru
desc: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.
motives: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Child of Night
features.desc: While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodthirsty
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru’s standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

features.name: Howl at the Moon
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Flesh Ripper
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d12+2 direct physical damage.

name: Sawtoothed Gillbeast
desc: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.
motives: Clamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline

features.name: Ka-Chomp
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 1d12 physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Feeding Frenzy
features.desc: When a creature marks HP, you can Spend a Fear to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.

features.name: Scaly
features.desc: When the Gillbeast would mark any number of HP, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can mark a Stress instead.

name: SELLSWORD
desc: An armed mercenary testing their luck.
motives: Charge, lacerate, overwhelm, profit

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Sellsword is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Sellsword, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Sellswords within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 3 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: SKELETON ARCHER
desc: A fragile skeleton with a shortbow and arrows.
motives: Perforate distracted targets, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Opportunist
features.desc: When two or more adversaries are within Very Close range of a creature, all damage the Archer deals to that creature is doubled.

features.name: Deadly Shot
features.desc: Make an attack against a Vulnerable target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 3d4+8 physical damage.

name: SKELETON DREDGE
desc: A clattering pile of bones.
motives: Fall apart, overwhelm, play dead, steal skin

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Dredge is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Dredge, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Dredges within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: SKELETON KNIGHT
desc: A large armored skeleton with a huge blade.
motives: Cut down the living, steal skin, wreak havoc

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Knight makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Cut to the Bone
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take 1d8+2 physical damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Dig Two Graves
features.desc: When the Knight is defeated, they make an attack against a target within Very Close range (prioritizing the creature who killed them). On a success, the target takes 1d4+8 physical damage and loses 1d4 Hope.

name: SKELETON WARRIOR
desc: A dirt-covered skeleton armed with a rusted blade.
motives: Feign death, gang up, steal skin

features.name: Only Bones
features.desc: The Warrior is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Won't Stay Dead
features.desc: When the Warrior is defeated, you can spotlight them and roll a d6. On a result of 6, if there are other adversaries on the battlefield, the Warrior re-forms with no marked HP.

name: Soul-Shattered Mage
desc: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.
motives: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Broken Magic
features.desc: Mark a Stress to roll a d6. The Mage uses the corresponding move: 1–2: **Dimension Rift**. Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes 2d6 direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble.  3–4: **Time Dilation**. Choose a group of PCs within Far range.  Each target is Slowed until they roll with Hope. While Slowed, a target is Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they move.  5–6: **Discordant Visions**. Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take 2d8 direct magic damage.

features.name: Feel My Pain
features.desc: When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

name: SPELLBLADE
desc: A mercenary combining swordplay and magic to deadly effect.
motives: Blast, command, endure

features.name: Arcane Steel
features.desc: Damage dealt by the Spellblade's standard attack is considered both physical and magic.

features.name: Suppressing Blast
features.desc: Mark a Stress and target a group within Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 1d8+2 magic damage. You gain a Fear for each target who marked HP from this attack.

features.name: Move as a Unit
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight up to five allies within Far range.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Spellblade makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Spellbound Armor
desc: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.
motives: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently

features.name: Tireless
features.desc: The Armor can’t be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.

features.name: Clatter & Recombobulate
features.desc: Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can spend a Fear to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

name: SWARM OF RATS
desc: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.
motives: Consume, obscure, swarm

features.name: Horde (1d4+1)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: In Your Face
features.desc: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.

name: SYLVAN SOLDIER
desc: A faerie warrior adorned in armor made of leaves and bark.
motives: Ambush, hide, overwhelm, protect, trail

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.desc: If the Soldier makes a standard attack and another Sylvan Soldier is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d8+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Forest Control
features.desc: Spend a Fear to pull down a tree within Close range. A creature hit by the tree must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (15) or take 1d10 physical damage.

features.name: Blend In
features.desc: When the Soldier makes a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to become Hidden until the Soldier's next attack or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll (14) to find them.

name: TANGLE BRAMBLE SWARM
desc: A cluster of animate, blood-drinking tumbleweeds, each the size of a large gourd.
motives: Digest, entangle, immobilize

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Crush
features.desc: Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+8 direct physical damage to a target with 3 or more bramble tokens.

features.name: Encumber
features.desc: When the Swarm succeeds on an attack, give the target a bramble token. If a target has any bramble tokens, they are Restrained. If a target has 3 or more bramble tokens, they are also Vulnerable. All bramble tokens can be removed by succeeding on a Finesse Roll (12 + the number of bramble tokens) or dealing Major or greater damage to the Swarm. If bramble tokens are removed from a target using a Finesse Roll, a number of Tangle Bramble Minions spawn within Melee range equal to the number of tokens removed.

name: TANGLE BRAMBLE
desc: An animate, blood-drinking tumbleweed.
motives: Combine, drain, entangle

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Bramble is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Tangle Bramble, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Tangle Brambles within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Drain and Multiply
features.desc: When an attack from the Bramble causes a target to mark HP and there are three or more Tangle Bramble Minions within Close range, you can combine the Minions into a Tangle Bramble Swarm Horde. The Horde's HP is equal to the number of Minions combined.

name: Viper
desc: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.
motives: Lie in wait, slither, strike

features.name: Minion (4)
features.desc: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous
features.desc: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Waxwork Creation
desc: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.
motives: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: No Vital Organs
features.desc: The Creation doesn’t take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

features.name: Wax Ball
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 1d12+2 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Splutch!
features.desc: When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker’s weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

features.name: Smothering Grapple
features.desc: When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to Trap the target inside the Creation’s wax body. While Trapped, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress and move with the Creation each time it’s spotlighted.  A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

name: WEAPONMASTER
desc: A master-at-arms wielding a sword twice their size.
motives: Act first, aim for the weakest, intimidate

features.name: Goading Strike
features.desc: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, mark a Stress to Taunt the target until their next successful attack. The next time the Taunted target attacks, they have disadvantage against targets other than the Weaponmaster.

features.name: Adrenaline Burst
features.desc: Once per scene, Spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Weaponmaster makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Will-O'-The-Wisps
desc: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.
motives: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray

features.name: Horde (1d4-1)
features.desc: When the Will-o’-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4−1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Kaleidoscopic
features.desc: The Will-o’-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o’-the-Wisps are Vulnerable.

features.name: Fascinating
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Will-o’-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or mark a Stress and move up to Close range toward the Will-o’-the-Wisps.

name: YOUNG DRYAD
desc: An imperious tree-person leading their forest's defenses.
motives: Command, nurture, prune the unwelcome

features.name: Voice of the Forest
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

features.name: Thorny Cage
features.desc: Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they're freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Yufo
desc: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.
motives: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows

features.name: Telepathic
features.desc: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.

features.name: Psychic Strongbox
features.desc: The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

features.name: Glitch Wave
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

features.name: Temporal Corrosion
features.desc: When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

name: BRAWNY ZOMBIE
desc: A large corpse, decay-bloated and angry.
motives: Crush, destroy, hail debris, slam

features.name: Slow
features.desc: When you spotlight the Zombie and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Zombie and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Rend Asunder
features.desc: Make a standard attack with advantage against a target the Zombie has Restrained. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Rip and Tear
features.desc: When the Zombies makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.

name: PATCHWORK ZOMBIE HULK
desc: A towering gestalt of corpses moving as one, with torso-sized limbs and fists as large as a grown halfling.
motives: Absorb corpses, flail, hunger, terrify

features.name: Destructible
features.desc: When the Zombie takes Major or greater damage, they mark an additional HP.

features.name: Flailing Limbs
features.desc: When the Zombie makes a standard attack, they can attack all targets within Very Close range.

features.name: Another for the Pile
features.desc: When the Zombie is within Very Close range of a corpse, they can incorporate it into themselves, clearing a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Tormented Screams
features.desc: Mark a Stress to cause all PCs within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail lose a Hope and you gain a Fear for each. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

name: ROTTED ZOMBIE
desc: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.
motives: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround

features.name: Minion (3)
features.desc: The Zombie is defeated when they take any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Zombie, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: SHAMBLING ZOMBIE
desc: An animated corpse that moves shakily, driven only by hunger.
motives: Devour, hungry, mob enemy, shred flesh

features.name: Too Many to Handle
features.desc: When the Zombie is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other Zombie is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

features.name: Horrifying
features.desc: Targets who mark HP from the Zombie's attacks must also mark a Stress.

name: ZOMBIE PACK
desc: A group of shambling corpses instinctively moving together.
motives: Consume flesh, hunger, maul

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc: When the Zombies have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Zombies mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: ARCHER SQUADRON
desc: A group of trained archers bearing massive bows.
motives: Stick together, survive, volley fire

features.name: Horde (1d6+3)
features.desc: When the Squadron has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d6+3 physical damage instead.

features.name: Focused Volley
features.desc: Spend a Fear to target a point within Far range. Make an attack with advantage against all targets within Close range of that point. Targets the Squadron succeeds against take 1d10+4 physical damage.

features.name: Suppressing Fire
features.desc: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Until the next roll with Fear, a creature who moves within Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d6+3 physical damage. On a success, they take half damage.

name: APPRENTICE ASSASSIN
desc: A young trainee eager to prove themselves.
motives: Act reckless, kill, prove their worth, show off

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Assassin is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Assassin, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Apprentice Assassins within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: ASSASSIN POISONER
desc: A cunning scoundrel skilled in both poisons and ambushing.
motives: Anticipate, get paid, kill, taint food and water

features.name: Grindletooth Venom
features.desc: Targets who mark HP from the Assassin's attacks are Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Out of Nowhere
features.desc: The Assassin has advantage on attacks if they are Hidden.

features.name: Fumigation
features.desc: Drop a smoke bomb that fills the air within Close range with smoke, Dizzying all targets in this area. Dizzied targets have disadvantage on their next action roll, then clear the condition.

name: MASTER ASSASSIN
desc: A seasoned killer with a threatening voice and a deadly blade.
motives: Ambush, get out alive, kill, prepare for all scenarios

features.name: Won't See It Coming
features.desc: The Assassin deals direct damage while they're Hidden.

features.name: Strike as One
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight a number of other Assassins equal to the Assassin's unmarked Stress.

features.name: The Subtle Blade
features.desc: When the Assassin successfully makes a standard attack against a Vulnerable target, you can Spend a Fear to deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Assassin makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Banshee
desc: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.
motives: Ambush from inside solid objects, frighten to death, mourn life and beauty lost, scream balefully

features.name: Specter
features.desc: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scare Tactic
features.desc: Up to three times per scene, spend a Fear to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

features.name: Wail of Despair
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d12+1 magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

name: Basilisk
desc: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.
motives: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait

features.name: Petrify
features.desc: Spend a Fear to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already Stiff, they become Petrified. While Stiff, the PC must mark a Stress each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can’t act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.

features.name: CRONCH!
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

name: BATTLE BOX
desc: A cube-shaped construct with a different rune on each of their six sides.
motives: Change tactics, trample foes, wait in disguise

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Box can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Randomized Tactics
features.desc:
Mark a Stress and roll a d6. The Box uses a corresponding move:
1. **Mana Beam**
The Box fires a searing beam. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 magic damage.
2. **Fire Jets**
The Box shoots into the air, spinning and releasing jets of flame. Make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 2d8 physical damage.
3. **Trample**
The Box rockets around erratically. Make an attack against all PCs within Close range. Targets the Box succeeds against take 1d6+5 physical damage and are Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.
4. **Shocking Gas**
The Box sprays out a silver gas sparking with lightning. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or mark 3 Stress.
5. **Stunning Clap**
The Box leaps and their sides clap, creating a small sonic boom. All targets within Very Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable until the cube is defeated.
6. **Psionic Whine**
The Box releases a cluster of mechanical bees whose buzz rattles mortal minds. All targets within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 2d4+9 direct magic damage.

features.name: Overcharge
features.desc: Before rolling damage for the Box's attack, you can mark a Stress to add a d6 to the damage roll. Additionally, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Death Quake
features.desc: When the Box marks their last HP, the magic powering them ruptures in an explosion of force. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 2d8+1 magic damage.

name: Berserker Alpha
desc: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.
motives: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

features.name: Bark at the Moon
features.desc: Once per scene, spend a Fear to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Berserker Initiate
desc: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.
motives: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

features.name: Pack Fury
features.desc: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack’s target.

features.name: Berserker Rage
features.desc: The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

name: Centaur Warden
desc: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motives: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

features.name: Flanking Maneuver
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden’s allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.

features.name: Eye of the Sage
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack.  The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

features.name: Trample
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 1d6+2 physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Quick Volley
features.desc: When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can mark any number of Stress to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

name: CHAOS SKULL
desc: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.
motives: Cackle, consume magic, serve creator

features.name: Levitation
features.desc: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can't be Restrained.

features.name: Wards
features.desc: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

features.name: Magic Burst
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

features.name: Siphon Magic
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.

name: Chicken-Foot Hut
desc: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.
motives: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

features.name: Fast
features.desc: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Pin
features.desc: When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target. The Hut drags the Restrained target when it moves.

name: CONSCRIPT
desc: A poorly trained civilian pressed into war.
motives: Follow orders, gang up, survive

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Conscript is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Conscript, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Conscripts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: COURTESAN
desc: An accomplished manipulator and master of the social arts.
motives: Entice, maneuver, secure patrons

features.name: Searing Glance
features.desc: When a PC within Close range makes a Presence Roll, you can mark a Stress to cast a gaze toward the aftermath. On the target's failure, they must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until the scene ends or they succeed on a social action against the Courtesan. On the target's success, they must mark a Stress.

name: CULT ADEPT
desc: An experienced mage wielding shadow and fear.
motives: Curry favor, hinder foes, uncover knowledge

features.name: Enervating Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target within range. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Shroud of the Fallen
features.desc: Mark a Stress to wrap an ally within Close range in a shroud of Protection until the Adept marks their last HP. While Protected, the target has resistance to all damage.

features.name: Shadow Shackles
features.desc: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point are Restrained in smoky chains until they break free with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll. A target Restrained by this feature must Spend a Hope to make an action roll.

features.name: Fear Is Fuel
features.desc: Twice per scene, when a PC rolls a failure with Fear, clear a Stress.

name: CULT FANG
desc: A professional killer-turned-cultist.
motives: Capture sacrifices, isolate prey, rise in the ranks

features.name: Shadow's Embrace
features.desc: The Fang can climb and walk on vertical surfaces. Mark a Stress to move from one shadow to another within Far range.

features.name: Pick Off the Straggler
features.desc: Mark a Stress to cause a target within Melee range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target must mark 2 Stress and is teleported with the Fang to a shadow within Far range, making them temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, the target must mark a Stress.

name: CULT INITIATE
desc: A low-ranking cultist in simple robes, eager to gain power.
motives: Follow orders, gain power, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Initiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Initiate, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cult Initiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: DEMONIC HOUND PACK
desc: Unnatural hounds lit from within by hellfire.
motives: Cause fear, consume flesh, please masters

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.desc: When the Pack has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Dreadhowl
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make all targets within Very Close range lose a Hope. If a target is not able to lose a Hope, they must instead mark 2 Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Pack makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Dire Pangolati
desc: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.
motives: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

features.name: Armor Eater
features.desc: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.

features.name: Blade Spin
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 physical damage.

features.name: Blade Fling
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals 2d6+10 physical damage.

features.name: Keratin Scales
features.desc: When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can mark a Stress to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

name: Doppelhound
desc: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.
motives: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive

features.name: Blink Beast
features.desc: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate’s. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate’s place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

name: Dragon Knight
desc: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon’s head.
motives: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above

features.name: High Ground
features.desc: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them.
