features.desc: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can't use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

name: Lamia
desc: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
motives: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

features.name: Constriction
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.desc: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.desc: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

name: Lamplight Beguiler
desc: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
motives: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

features.name: Doppel-Dangler
features.desc: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler’s head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form.  Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler’s head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

features.name: Entice
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler’s head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

features.name: Gulp
features.desc: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

name: Manticore
desc: A legendary beast that has a human’s face, lion’s body, scorpion’s tail, and dragon’s wings.
motives: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Riddle Me This
features.desc: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Winged
features.desc: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Pouncing Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope.  While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Paralyzing Tail Spike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Locking Jaws
features.desc: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

name: MONARCH
desc: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.
motives: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy

features.name: Execute Them!
features.desc: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Crownsguard
features.desc: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch's will.

features.name: Casus Belli
features.desc: Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch's desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

name: Night Children
desc: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
motives: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

features.name: Horde (2d6+2)
features.desc: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Swell Ranks
features.desc: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde’s ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: Pain Priest
desc: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.
motives: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

features.name: Walk Between Worlds
features.desc: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Pleasure and Pain
features.desc: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

name: Phoenix
desc: A huge eagle that’s made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
motives: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

features.name: Purifying Aura
features.desc: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix’s Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Fireseed
features.desc: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

features.name: Resurrection
features.desc: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

name: Plesiosaurus
desc: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
motives: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

features.name: Only a Rumor
features.desc: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can’t be located or targeted.

features.name: Wall of Water
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

name: Roc
desc: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
motives: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Bird of Prey
features.desc: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Here Comes the Boom
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Crushing Grasp
features.desc: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).

features.name: Nest Warden
features.desc: When the Roc’s eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

features.name: Wrathful
features.desc: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

features.name: Electrifying Aura
features.desc: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

name: Sandwyrm
desc: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
motives: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

features.name: Venomous Tail Stinger
features.desc: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Devour
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Hungry, Not Stupid
features.desc: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend
desc: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.
motives: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal

features.name: Fiendish Nature
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonate
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with.  A PC who targets the Fiend while they’re in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Turn Invisible
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Backhanded Guidance
features.desc: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Exposed! (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

name: Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed
desc: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.
motives: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Fiendish Resistance
features.desc: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Demonic Rage
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Hall of Mirrors
features.desc: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4).  When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Flash Claw
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

features.name: Mind Games
features.desc: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

name: STAG KNIGHT
desc: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.
motives: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome

features.name: From Above
features.desc: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Blade of the Forest
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target's Major threshold.

features.name: Thorny Armor
features.desc: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

name: Storm Titan
desc: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.
motives: Erupt violently, wait, watch

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Ball Lightning
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range.  When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Storm Bringer
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.desc: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: OAK TREANT
desc: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.
motives: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches

features.name: Just a Tree
features.desc: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Seed Barrage
features.desc: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

features.name: Take Root
features.desc: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

name: TREANT SAPLING
desc: A small, sentient tree sapling.
motives: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround

features.name: Minion (6)
features.desc: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Unicorn
desc: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.
motives: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent

features.name: Celestial Lance
features.desc: The Unicorn’s standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.desc: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally’s HP.

features.name: Protective Aura
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teleport
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

name: HEAD VAMPIRE
desc: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
motives: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Look into My Eyes
features.desc: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

features.name: Feed on Followers
features.desc: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: The Hunt Is On
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Lifesuck
features.desc: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

name: VAMPIRE
desc: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator's smile.
motives: Bite, charm, deceive, feed, intimidate

features.name: Draining Bite
features.desc: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: Mistform
features.desc: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can Spend a Fear to take half damage.

name: Vampire Bat Swarm
desc: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.
motives: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease

features.name: Horde (2d6)
features.desc: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Blinding Multitude
features.desc: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Bloodsuckers
features.desc: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

name: Vampire Lord
desc: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.
motives: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Midnight Heart
features.desc: _Long-Term Countdown (6)_. The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it’s destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Unleash Hellfire
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Resurgence
features.desc: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Hellwing
features.desc:
When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the “On Crimson Wings” and “Bloodbath” features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack:
**Claws**: Close | 3d12+6 phy

features.name: On Crimson Wings
features.desc: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bloodblath
features.desc: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

name: VAULT GUARDIAN GAOLER
desc: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.
motives: Carry away, entrap, protect, pummel

features.name: Blocking Shield
features.desc: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

features.name: Lock Up
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

name: VAULT GUARDIAN SENTINEL
desc: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.
motives: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect

features.name: Kinetic Slam
features.desc: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel's standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Box In
features.desc: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they're within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Mana Bolt
features.desc: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren't knocked back.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: VAULT GUARDIAN TURRET
desc: A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve pistondriven mechanical legs.
motives: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect

features.name: Slow Firing
features.desc: When you spotlight the Turret and they don't have a token on their stat block, they can't make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they're preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Mark Target
features.desc: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrate Fire
features.desc: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonation
features.desc: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Viscera Sucker
desc: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.
motives: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Join or Die
features.desc: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn’t reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Entangling Entrails
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Lifesuck
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

name: Whisper Wraith
desc: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.
motives: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads

features.name: Great Specter
features.desc: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Spooky
features.desc: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Nightmare Shroud
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

name: Wyvern
desc: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.
motives: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Double Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn’t gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.desc: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Young Fire Dragon
desc: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.
motives: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidating
features.desc: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

features.name: Flame Breath
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range.  Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Blazing Scales
features.desc: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Slash and Burn
features.desc: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

name: YOUNG ICE DRAGON
desc: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.
motives: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rend and Crush
features.desc: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn't mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: No Hope
features.desc: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Blizzard Breath
features.desc: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Avalanche
features.desc: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Frozen Scales
features.desc: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: ARCH-NECROMANCER
desc: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.
motives: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day,resurrect

features.name: Dance of Death
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you Spend a Fear.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.desc: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Not Today, My Dears
features.desc: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can Spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: Your Life Is Mine
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

name: FALLEN SHOCK TROOP
desc: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.
motives: Crush, dominate, earn relief, punish

features.name: Minion (12)
features.desc: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura of Doom
features.desc: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: FALLEN SORCERER
desc: A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life.
motives: Acquire, dishearten, dominate, torment

features.name: Conflagration
features.desc: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.desc: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.desc: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Shackles of Guilt
features.desc: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

name: FALLEN WARLORD: REALM-BREAKER
desc: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.
motives: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.desc: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage
features.desc: Countdown (Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.desc: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

name: FALLEN WARLORD: UNDEFEATED CHAMPION
desc: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.
motives: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.desc: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.desc: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement
features.desc: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.desc: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

name: HALLOWED ARCHER
desc: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.
motives: Focus fire, obey, reposition, volley

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.desc: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

name: HALLOWED SOLDIER
desc: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.
motives: Obey, outmaneuver, punish, swarm

features.name: Minion (13)
features.desc: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.desc: While the Soldier is flying, Spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: HIGH SERAPH
desc: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.
motives: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.desc: While the Seraph is flying, Spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.desc: Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.desc: Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.desc: Once per scene, Spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: KRAKEN
desc: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.
motives: Consume, crush, drown, grapple

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.desc: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.desc: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.desc: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.desc: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: ORACLE OF DOOM
desc: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.
motives: Change environment, condemn, dishearten,toss aside

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.desc: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.desc: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d20+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.desc: Once per day, Spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.desc: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.desc: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

name: OUTER REALMS ABOMINATION
desc: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.
motives: Demolish, devour, undermine

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.desc: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.desc: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.desc: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Unreal Form
features.desc: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

name: OUTER REALMS CORRUPTER
desc: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.
motives: Confuse, distract, overwhelm

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.desc: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.desc: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

name: OUTER REALMS THRALL
desc: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.
motives: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate

features.name: Minion (13)
features.desc: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.desc: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: VOLCANIC DRAGON: MOLTEN SCOURGE
desc: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.
motives: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel Invaders, reposition

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.desc: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d8+1 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruption
features.desc: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a d10. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lava Splash
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals 2d10+4 direct physical damage to the attacker.

features.name: Ashen Vengeance (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

name: VOLCANIC DRAGON: OBSIDIAN PREDATOR
desc: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.
motives: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Flying
features.desc: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.desc: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 4d6+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.desc: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Erupting Rage (Phase Change)
features.desc: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

name: VOLCANIC DRAGON: ASHEN TYRANT
desc: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it's ground to ash like the dragon's past foes.
motives: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.desc: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cornered
features.desc: Mark a Stress instead of Spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.desc: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.desc: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.desc: Spend a Fear to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
features.desc: Countdown (1d12). Spend a Fear to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

name: PERFECTED ZOMBIE
desc: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.
motives: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

features.name: Terrifying
features.desc: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.desc: PCs can't Spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.desc: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are Vulnerable until their next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.desc: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can Spend a Fear to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

name: ZOMBIE LEGION
desc: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.
motives: Consume brain, shred flesh, surround

features.name: Horde (2d6+5)
features.desc: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.desc: The Legion has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.desc: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.desc: When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.
